digest.component_or_area: LLM runner structured output and retry logic
propositions: Manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured must be replaced with a single bounded Agent operation that preserves all input and responses in one run

History projection via HistoryProcessor must include failed ModelResponse on retry wire only when full request plus output reserve fits the context window, omitting responses that would exceed window limits
Truncation-triggered output retry must send exactly the concision instruction via ModelRetry and consume only the shared output-retry allowance, never per-attempt resetting the budget
Authoritative-input overflow must raise ContextWindowExceededError without shortening any system/user/tool content
NativeOutput branch must preserve output_mode selection, bug-895c grammar fallback, terminal truncation, and attach pai_output.guard_capability() instead of concision guard

Combined request budget must be computed once in build_usage_limits as base plus output-retry allowance with no per-attempt reset, and returned req_limit must remain bare base for telemetry and banking inverse accuracy
